source.author: verg
source.text: Consumptis hic forte aliis ut vertere morsus exiguam in Cererem penuria adegit edendi et violare manu malisque audacibus orbem fatalis crusti patulis nec parcere quadris:
source.text_original: Consumptis hic forte aliis ut vertere morsus / exiguam in Cererem penuria adegit edendi / et violare manu malisque audacibus orbem / fatalis crusti patulis nec parcere quadris: /
source.text_english: Here, when the others had perhaps been used up, want of food forced them to turn their bites upon the scanty Ceres, and to violate with their hands and greedy boldness the round of the fateful crust, not sparing even the open squares:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: quasi Aeneas noua castra metaris et super undam Thybridis, ubi ille cogente quondam penuria crustis fatalibus et quadris patulis non pepercit, tu uiculum nostrum, id est domum panis, aedificas et diuturnam famem repentina saturitate compensas.
reuse.text_original: quasi Aeneas noua castra metaris et super undam Thybridis, ubi ille cogente quondam penuria crustis fatalibus et quadris patulis non pepercit, tu uiculum nostrum, id est domum panis, aedificas et diuturnam famem repentina saturitate compensas.
reuse.text_english: as though you were measuring out a new camp for Aeneas and, above the wave of the Tiber, where once, under the pressure of need, he did not spare the fated crusts and broad squares, you are building our little village, that is, the house of bread, and making up for a long famine with a sudden fullness.
